task.title: Install HP LaserJet Driver on Windows 11
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to install the HP LaserJet driver on Windows 11, including handling User Account Control (UAC) prompts and configuring network settings.

prereq.p: Ensure that your computer is connected to the internet and that you have administrative privileges.

step.cmd: Download the latest HP LaserJet driver from the HP support website.
step.result: The driver package is saved to your computer.

step.cmd: Double-click the downloaded driver package to begin the installation.
Follow the on-screen instructions in the installation wizard.
When prompted by User Account Control (UAC), click Yes to allow the installation to proceed.
step.result: The installation continues with elevated permissions.

step.cmd: Configure the network settings as prompted by the installation wizard.
step.result: The printer is connected to the network.

step.cmd: Review the default network timeout settings in the configuration reference.
step.result: The correct default value is applied.

step.cmd: Complete the installation by following any remaining prompts.
step.result: The HP LaserJet driver is successfully installed on your Windows 11 computer.
